newsitem.title: RWANDA: Rwandan justice minister resigns - state radio.
newsitem.headline: Rwandan justice minister resigns - state radio.

text.p: Rwandan Justice Minister Martha Mukamurenzi has resigned over "problems" in her ministry, state radio said on Wednesday.
The radio said Mukamurenzi's resignation on Tuesday was announced by Prime Minister Pierre Celestin Rwigema and came after consultations between the Rwigema and Mukamurenzi, both Hutus.
No specific details for her resignation were available.
